summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT, 0 MUST-FIX and 0 SHOULD-FIX. The subject did not move and is still mode 0444; HEAD, COORD, file 08, the last heading D-300, required-now 28, both frozen predecessors, all four predecessor reviews and the single fixture all match the dispatch. The two v9 MUST-FIX classes have not regressed: N=65536 is not pinned, and the residue keeps both prefix-exactly-at and the postHandshake half. The bare-version-token audit passes at 0 collisions with 11 and 0 deictic uses. Three advisories are the unrepaired v10 advisories restated against v11 bytes, and four observations are recorded; none is a bar.
